stem: Which statement shows an effect of the First Amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: Ministers can preach religious messages to anyone who chooses to listen.

options.label: B
options.text: Political leaders can require religious tests in order to hold public office.

options.label: C
options.text: Ministers can work together to establish a national religion.

options.label: D
options.text: Political leaders can require churches to pay taxes.
